gates.title: Safety checks before Noa acts
gates.ruleTip: Noa’s published rule table: every decision names the rule it used
gates.label: Safety checks this case passes through, in order

plain.humanWaiting: Waiting for a person to approve

consent.pass: {{n}} consent records on file. Nothing is shared outside them.
consent.none: No consent on file, so nothing is shared.
consent.nobody: No one is chosen to see the plan, so it stays closed.

data.pass: Every input is present and in its plausible range.
data.passWarn_one: Inputs are usable. {{count}} warning to read below.
data.passWarn_other: Inputs are usable. {{count}} warnings to read below.

urgent.pending: Noa has not looked for a sudden change yet.
urgent.check: Noa is checking for a sudden change: waiting for the speech check.
urgent.bypassed: Urgent rule {{rule}}: the routine flow is skipped and the emergency call comes first.
urgent.bypassedFam: A red alert is open: it jumps the routine queue.
urgent.pass: No sudden change: the routine flow continues.

rule.check: Waiting for the speech check and the answer before a rule can fire.
rule.ask: Waiting for the person’s answer before a rule can fire.

human.none: No action was raised, so no one needs to confirm.
human.hold: Waiting for the care team to accept (step {{n}}).
human.holdEm: The 998 call does not wait for approval. The care team approves the follow-up plan at step {{n}}.
human.bypassEm: Not required for the 998 call. Approval applies to the follow-up plan.
human.holdFam: Waiting for a person to book or accept.
human.pass: A person or care team accepted the action.

prov.homeReadings: Readings from the watch, sensors and the person

observed.label: Observed
observed.desc: Read from a sensor, a record, or entered by a person

calculated.label: Calculated
calculated.desc: Worked out by a rule or a formula

ai.label: AI-written
ai.desc: Wording written by AI. It explains; it never decides

clinician.label: Clinician confirmed
clinician.desc: A clinician or care team accepted it

passport.calculated: what is due and the rule

daily.observed: the reading and the speech answer

usual.label: Today’s speech score against the usual one
usual.lower: Today’s score is {{diff}} below {{n}}’s usual {{usual}}. Noa looks at the change from the person’s own baseline.
usual.same: Today’s score is the same as {{n}}’s usual {{usual}}.

issue.blocked: Noa cannot run until the value above is fixed.
